intent: TEST for BroadcastingService at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/broadcasting/application/BroadcastingService.java. JUnit 5 + AssertJ (+ Mockito, reactor-test StepVerifier for reactive code); cover every invariant and behavior below, including failure cases, using only the pinned surfaces of collaborators. Unit under test: Telemetry Stream Broadcasting use case implementing BroadcastTelemetryUseCase. Constructor BroadcastingService(TelemetryStreamGateway gateway, BoundedEventChannel<TelemetryStreamPublishedEvent> streamPublications, Clock clock). broadcastSample/broadcastWindow map to BroadcastItem, publish through the gateway, then publish TelemetryStreamPublishedEvent(kind, deviceId, sampleCount, clock.instant()); a failure publishing that audit event is swallowed (onErrorResume) so it never blocks broadcasting. stream(deviceId) = gateway.items() filtered by deviceId when non-null. Broadcasting never influences ordering.
